name: Kuzumaki (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kuzumaki town emblem in white: an outlined interlaced triquetra of three loops.
history: Municipal flag of Kuzumaki, a town in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 December 1978.

features.role: Kuzumaki town emblem — an outlined interlaced triquetra of three loops
